For the automatic deletion of unknown APK/AAB files to work, the app needs access to all storage. This helps keep your device clean and safe.
For the app blocking feature to work, you need to grant \'Usage Data Access\'. This helps the app know when an unauthorized app is opened.

SOS uses the Accessibility Service to record your last interaction with the phone, enabling prompt rescue calls if abnormal signs are detected. We are committed to absolute privacy: the app does not read screen content, record text, or interfere with personal settings. All activity data is stored securely on your device and used solely for emergency rescue purposes.
does not read screen content, record text, or interfere with personal settings
Detects real user activity for SOS inactivity checks.

Used only by Auto SOS to detect whether the phone is still being actively used. The service listens only for the system event that indicates the user has started touching the screen, then saves the latest activity time on this device. It does not read screen content, collect typed text, inspect other apps, change settings, perform gestures, click buttons, or share this activity data.
This feature helps protect users by only allowing selected apps to run. Other apps will be blocked to avoid unintended issues.
To ensure safety, the app will automatically call the quick contact list if no user interaction is detected on the phone.
automatically call the quick contact list
This feature helps protect users by automatically deleting unknown installation files (APK) downloaded to the device, avoiding accidental installation of malware.
This feature helps protect users by automatically blocking calls from unknown numbers not in the contacts, avoiding being bothered by ads or scams.
